UNISTOR GLOBAL PTY LTD
RUTHERFORD NSW 2320
SALARY: $79,400 to $95,000 PER ANNUM

UNISTOR GLOBAL PTY LTD is a leading construction and renovation company specializing in residential and commercial projects. We are committed to delivering high-quality craftsmanship and exceptional service to our clients. We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Civil Engineering Draftsperson to join our dynamic team.
The Civil Engineering Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing detailed sketches, charts, plans, and designs for various projects. This role involves both office-based drafting work and fieldwork, ensuring the quality and compliance of our installations and custom solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Drafting and Design:
o	Prepare detailed sketches, charts, tabulations, plans, and designs for ongoing projects.
o	Liaising with structural engineers, architects & clients on a regular basis to ensure project fluidity
o	Organizing design meetings with team members to discuss fabrication, install & other queries

•	Fieldwork and Testing:
o	Perform and direct fieldwork, including site inspections and surveys, to gather data and ensure project specifications are met.
o	Conduct laboratory testing of construction materials to ensure quality and compliance with industry standards.

•	Data Collection and Analysis:
o	Collect and analyse data related to construction materials and soil conditions.
o	Carry out necessary computations to support project design and execution.

•	Cost Estimation and Compliance:
o	Estimate material costs for projects, ensuring that all works are completed within budget and meet regulatory requirements.
o	Inspect, overseeing junior draughtsman works to ensure adherence to specifications, regulations, and contract provisions.

•	Maintenance and Supervision:
o	Organize and supervise maintenance and repair work for existing installations.
o	Ensure all field and laboratory activities are conducted safely and efficiently.

Qualifications:
•	At least a Diploma or a minimum of three years of experience.
•	At least two years of experience proven experience in civil engineering drafting and design, preferably within the construction industry.
•	Proficiency in CAD software, Tekla Structures and other relevant drafting tools.
•	Strong understanding of civil engineering principles, materials, and construction methods.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to interpret technical instructions and apply appropriate procedures.
•	Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality workmanship.
•	Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team.

SALARY: $79,400 to $95,000 PER ANNUM

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers in all states of Australia through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

Our Opportunity
Due to exponential growth, Nepean Conveyors is seeking Senior Mechanical Engineer to join their team located in Mackay Qld.

Your daily duties will include however are not limited to;
Prepares and supervises the preparation of mechanical engineering designs, drawings, specifications, schedules, quantity and cost estimates for a wide range of new construction and maintenance improvement projects.
Plans, schedules and coordinates detailed phases of mechanical engineering work either as part of a major project or for an entire project of smaller scope.
Reviews contractors' mechanical submittals and works to ensure compliance with plans and specifications.
Reviews consultant’s mechanical designs and submittal packages.
Makes field investigations of existing facilities.

Makes difficult engineering calculations and analysis in connection with mechanical design of utility systems and transportation facilities; supervise the preparation of detailed drawings for these facilities.
Inspects and supervises a wide variety of ordinary and complex construction projects to ensure compliance with contract plans and specifications.
Assists in the preparation of complex contract documents.
Prepares correspondence and prepare technical engineering reports in connection with a wide variety of projects.
Works on a team with other engineers, drafting technicians and contracts personnel on planning, developing and finalizing technical and construction contract documents.

To be considered for this opportunity, the right person will have:
Min 5 years’ experience within a similar role
Appropriate qualification/training.
Technical competence
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Rights to work in Australia

If you're ready for your next challenge, please "Apply Now" and forward through your interest today!
Salary: $140,000 per annum + Super

Perth, Full Time, Construction
Vacancy Listing Dates 14/07/2026 to 11/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17581
- Seeking qualified applicants
- Full time opportunity
- Join the ECC United team working across Perth and WA

Company Overview:

Based in Perth, Western Australia, ECC United Pty Ltd are an established and growing construction company specialising in residential projects, with a strong expansion into the commercial construction sector. Our work includes:
- Construction: ECC United (elemental construction and consulting) is expanding its services to include the planning and delivery of multi-unit residential developments, comprising 20 to 30 dwellings with integrated roads, parking, landscaped open spaces, and community facilities. This expansion strengthens our capability to deliver larger, sustainable developments while maintaining our commitment to quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance.
- Consultation
- Site assessments
- Land management
- Regulatory compliance

We pride ourselves on operational excellence, quality, and strict regulatory compliance across all our sites.

About the position:

The Environmental & Project Compliance Officer will manage our in-house environmental compliance frameworks while providing necessary operational support to our project delivery teams. Key responsibilities including:
- Prepare, lodge, and manage Environmental Management Plans (EMPs) required for development approvals across Councils
- Prepare and review environmental compliance reports, Bushfire Attack Level (BAL) assessments where applicable, and other supporting documentation required for project approvals.
- Coordinate and interpret geotechnical assessments, site classifications, and Acid Sulphate Soil (ASS) management plans. Oversee erosion, sediment, and sand drift controls on active sites
- Develop, implement, and monitor Site Waste Minimisation Plans in accordance with Western Australian resource recovery and environmental policies.
- Conduct regular environmental and safety inspections across residential and commercial sites to ensure compliance with dust, noise, vibration, and chemical storage bylaws. Maintain accurate compliance logs for final council sign-offs
- Assess site conditions and provide recommendations for soil management, land rehabilitation, stormwater management, irrigation, and drainage solutions.
- Identify and implement sustainability initiatives to minimise environmental impacts and improve resource efficiency during construction.
- Review survey information, engineering drawings, and environmental documentation to support planning and construction activities.
- Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, local authorities, and regulatory agencies on environmental matters.
- Assist with project documentation, including material take-offs, environmental compliance records, and variation documentation where environmental considerations are involved.
- Support Site Supervisors by monitoring environmental aspects of Work Health and Safety (WHS), maintaining environmental incident records, and contributing to environmental site inductions and awareness programs.

Required:
- Tertiary qualification in Environmental Science, Agricultural Science, Environmental Engineering, or a highly analytical/scientific discipline.
- Ideally at least one year of experience in the relevant field.
- Strong foundational knowledge in soil science, and environmental reporting.
- Exceptional report-writing and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret technical data and translate it into practical site solutions.
- Highly organised with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced construction environment.
- Current WA Driver’s License and a White Card (Construction Induction).

Location: HQ: Perth, WA, across different sites

Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 plus super

You excel at dealing with operational challenges in a tightly resourced environment and the people issues that comes with this business.
